name: Business Events (GA)
description: **Overview**Business Events is now generally available in Microsoft Fabric, providing a governed, end-to-end experience for defining, publishing, discovering, consuming, and monitoring meaningful business signals across Fabric.**Key Capabilities**• Unified Business Event Experience: Create, discover, publish, consume, and manage Business Events directly from Real-Time hub.• Multiple Native Publishers: Publish events from Eventstream, Activator, Notebook, and User Data Functions.• Flexible Event Consumption: Connect Business Events to Activator, Eventstream, Eventhouse, notebooks, and User Data Functions.• Governed Event Schemas: Define and manage reusable event contracts through Schema Registry, including schema versioning and validation.• Data Preview and Observability: Inspect recent events by publisher or consumer to validate payloads, monitor event flow, and troubleshoot delivery.• Role-Based Data Access: Control who can publish and consume events through data access roles.• Low-Code and Pro-Code Support: Build event-driven solutions through guided UI experiences or programmable APIs.• Integrated Lifecycle Management: Manage publishers, consumers, schemas, permissions, and operational insights from a unified experience.
